messages:
rachel: Opening 90m change window to run a canary for Python + TS SDKs. Plan: publish canary tag `canary-3665432100`, route 7% internal test cohort, run smoke + quick perf harness. @sam you on publish, @maria_s please sketch a short note.

sam: Builds green locally. Will push npm dist-tag and pypi staging now. Command: `npm publish --tag canary-3665432100` then `twine upload -r testpypi dist/*`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started for canary-3665432100 -> internal npm + pypi-staging. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3665432100/logs

omar: Feature flag set to 7% (`sdk_canary_rollout`). Adding monitors for p50/p99 latency, error-rate, memory. Abort if p99 > +10% or errors >1%.

maria_s: Drafted release-note snippet: "Internal canary only; no GA changes. Note: legacy sync client deprecation reminder included." Draft: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/canary-3665432100

ken: Observing a small error uptick (1.5%) in ap-northeast-1 for canary. No latency spike yet.

omar: Pausing rollout and collecting traces. Can someone remove the tag until we diagnose?

sam: Running: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-3665432100` and deleting staging wheel. Flipping feature flag back to 0%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback executed. Dist-tag removed; traffic reverted to stable. Rollback CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3665432100/rollback status: success :white_check_mark:

rachel: Thanks. Quick postmortem: error due to a telemetry change that mis-handled a null header in certain proxy paths. Action items: revert telemetry tweak on canary branch, add unit test for header parsing, re-run canary next Tue 08:00 UTC.

maria_s: Updating release notes: "Canary paused for investigation; stable unchanged. Investigation ticket: https://tickets.redwood.example/INC-8721" I'll add migration pointers and note about sync client deprecation separately.

sam: Opening pinback PR for internal infra to pin to 1.3.3: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/512.

rachel: Closing window. We'll keep public changelog unchanged and share an internal summary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
